tasks.title: User Authentication Setup
tasks.description: Implement user registration and login functionality.
tasks.details: Use HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to create a registration and login form. Store user credentials in localStorage for MVP. Ensure protected pages are inaccessible without login.
tasks.testStrategy: Test registration and login with valid and invalid credentials. Ensure protected pages redirect to login if not authenticated.

tasks.title: Dashboard Implementation
tasks.description: Develop the dashboard to display pet status and provide core functionalities.
tasks.details: Create a dashboard page using HTML and CSS. Implement pet status display, video streaming area, and buttons for capture, record, and voice output using JavaScript.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify each button's functionality: capture, record, and voice output. Check real-time updates on the dashboard.

tasks.title: Journal and Gallery Feature
tasks.description: Implement the journal and gallery for storing and viewing photos and diaries.
tasks.details: Develop a page to upload, view, edit, and delete photos and diary entries. Use localStorage to save data temporarily.
tasks.testStrategy: Test photo upload, edit, and delete functionalities. Ensure diary entries can be created, viewed, and removed.

subtasks.title: Implement Photo Upload Feature
subtasks.description: Add functionality to upload photos to the gallery.
subtasks.details: Develop a form to select and upload photos. Integrate with existing gallery.js to handle uploads.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test photo upload with various file types and sizes.

subtasks.title: Enhance Empty State UX
subtasks.description: Improve user experience when no photos or diaries are present.
subtasks.details: Design and implement a user-friendly message or graphic for empty states in the gallery and journal.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify empty state displays correctly when no data is present.

subtasks.title: Implement Search and Filter for Photos and Diaries
subtasks.description: Add search and filter capabilities to the gallery and journal.
subtasks.details: Use JavaScript to enable search by keywords and filter by date or tags in gallery.js and storage.js.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test search and filter with various criteria and ensure accurate results.

subtasks.title: Integrate Dashboard Preview with Gallery and Journal
subtasks.description: Ensure the dashboard preview displays recent photos and diary entries.
subtasks.details: Modify dashboard implementation to pull recent entries from localStorage and display them.
subtasks.testStrategy: Check that the dashboard updates with the latest entries from the gallery and journal.

subtasks.title: Verify Data Synchronization with Dashboard
subtasks.description: Ensure data consistency between the gallery, journal, and dashboard preview.
subtasks.details: Test synchronization of data updates between the gallery, journal, and dashboard to ensure consistency.
subtasks.testStrategy: Perform updates in the gallery and journal and verify changes reflect on the dashboard.

tasks.title: Settings Page Development
tasks.description: Create a settings page for personalizing user preferences.
tasks.details: Develop a settings page to save pet name, notification preferences, API keys, and other settings using localStorage.
tasks.testStrategy: Test saving and retrieving settings after page refresh. Validate input fields for correct data types.

tasks.title: AI Chatbot Integration
tasks.description: Integrate an AI chatbot for pet-related inquiries.
tasks.details: Use OpenAI API or Cloudflare Worker to implement a chatbot interface. Ensure responses are in Korean and relevant to pet care.
tasks.testStrategy: Test chatbot with various pet-related questions. Ensure responses are accurate and in Korean.

tasks.title: Responsive Design Implementation
tasks.description: Ensure the web service is responsive and user-friendly on mobile devices.
tasks.details: Use CSS media queries to adjust layouts for different screen sizes. Ensure all elements are accessible and usable on mobile devices.
tasks.testStrategy: Test the web service on various devices and screen sizes. Check for layout issues and usability.

tasks.title: Error Handling and Feedback
tasks.description: Implement error handling and user feedback mechanisms.
tasks.details: Add error messages and feedback for user actions. Ensure errors are descriptive and guide users to resolve issues.
tasks.testStrategy: Induce errors and verify that appropriate messages are displayed. Ensure feedback is clear and helpful.

tasks.title: Data Persistence Enhancement
tasks.description: Plan for future data persistence beyond localStorage.
tasks.details: Research and design a backend solution for data storage. Consider using a database and server-side logic for future scalability.
tasks.testStrategy: Draft a plan and validate it with potential backend technologies. Ensure it aligns with current frontend architecture.

tasks.title: Hardware Integration Planning
tasks.description: Prepare for future integration with Raspberry Pi and other hardware.
tasks.details: Outline the steps needed to integrate hardware components like cameras and motors. Plan API endpoints and data flow.
tasks.testStrategy: Create a prototype plan and validate feasibility with existing hardware components. Ensure compatibility with the current system.

tasks.title: Notification System Setup
tasks.description: Implement a basic notification system for user alerts.
tasks.details: Develop a notification system using JavaScript to alert users of important events. Use email or browser notifications as a temporary solution.
tasks.testStrategy: Test notifications for various events. Ensure they are timely and informative.
